message: Built precipitation-proxy flood-onset labels. These are NOT official flood extents or verified events.

provenance.license_note: Derived product — not an official flood catalog
quality_limitations: Proxy from rainfall thresholds only — high false-alarm risk.
Not calibrated to local flood authority criteria.

Global Flood Database (MODIS) requires Google Earth Engine authentication. Authenticate EE separately, or place a GeoJSON/CSV of flood events under backend/data/raw/flood_events/ and call the local loader. Until then, precipitation-proxy labels are available and marked as estimated.
